result.topic_en: Gauss derives a recursive system of linear equations for the coefficients A, B, C, D, E of a series, states the general n-th equation with its coefficient law, and rewrites the equations by splitting each right-hand side into two parts.

$16[5]-9[3]$ | $16B-9A = 7-532A+3696B-7168C+4096D$
$25[6]-16[4]$ | $0 = 9-1116A+12720B-43776C+57600D-25600E$

ubi coëfficientes legi generali facile subiiciuntur. Scilicet aequatio $n^{ta}$ erit
$nnN-(n-1)^2L = (2n-1)\Big(1-4A\times\frac{[-3nn-]3nn-3n+2}{1.2}+16B\times\frac{n.n-1.5nn-5n+6}{1.2.3.4}$
$-16C\times\frac{n+1.n.n-1.n-2.7nn-7n+12}{1.2.3.4.5.6}$
$+64D\times\frac{n+2.n+1.n.n-1.n-2.n-3.9nn-9n+20}{1.2.3.4.5.6.7.8}-\text{etc.}\Big)$ *)
ubi factorum progressio obvia est (puta praeter factores simplices in singulos coëfficientes ingreditur factor duplex talis $knn-kn+\frac{1}{4}(kk-1)$).
Hae aequationes simplicius sequenti modo exhibentur, singularum membris ad dextram in binas partes discerptis (praeter aequ. primam quae immutata retinetur):
$0 = 1-4A$
$4A-1 = \begin{pmatrix}3-36A\\ -12A+64B\end{pmatrix}$
$0 = \begin{pmatrix}5-180A+400B\\ -20A+320B-576C\end{pmatrix}$
$16B-9A = \begin{pmatrix}7-504A+2800B-3136C\\ -28A+896B-4032C+4096D\end{pmatrix}$
$0 = \begin{pmatrix}9-1080A+10800B-28224[?]C+20736[?]D\\ -36A+1920B-15552C+36864D-25600E\end{pmatrix}$ etc
[scilicet generaliter aequatio $n^{ta}$
$nnN-(n-1)^2L = (2n-1)\Big\{1-3.4A\frac{n.n-1}{1.2}+5.16B\frac{n+1.n.n-1.n-2}{1.2.3.4}-7.64C\frac{n+2.n+1\ldots n-3}{1.2\ldots6}$
$\quad -4A.\frac{2}{1.2}+16B\frac{n.n-1.16}{1.2.3.4}-64C\frac{n+1.n.n-1.n-2.54}{1.2.3.4.5.6}$
*) $L$ et $N$ hic sunt vel utraque $=0$ (quando $n$ impar), vel resp. [-te-] terminis $\frac{1}{2}n^{tis}$, $\frac{1}{2}n+1^{tis}$ seriei $1, A, B, C, D, E$ etc. aequales.
